subject: Onboarding: model eval shortlist + 6-month token forecast
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Klein <alex.klein@cleartrace.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@cleartrace.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding: initial model shortlist & traffic ask

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday — great to see ClearTrace moving quickly. To get our CS -> Implementation handoff in motion, can you confirm the quick items below so the inference team can build an initial sizing recommendation? I put a short token profile file in the attachment (cleartrace_token_profile.xlsx).

Key asks (one-line answers are totally fine):
- Typical prompt length (tokens) for the user flows you care about (e.g., search summarization, agent assist)
- Typical generated response length you expect back (tokens)
- Average daily active users / API calls per day and any predictable seasonal spikes (percent uplift)
- Any hard constraints on latency (p50/p95) or availability (SLA) for these flows
- Data sensitivity notes: any PII, PHI, or regulated data in prompts/outputs?

What we'll do after you confirm: 1) propose a 2–3 model shortlist with context-length variants (2k/8k/32k where relevant), 2) map to preliminary token volumes and peak QPS, and 3) recommend Dedicated sizing or hosted routing mix for the first 90 days.

Attached: cleartrace_token_profile.xlsx (simple token samples + example prompts)

Thanks — Monica

--
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

From: Alex Klein <alex.klein@cleartrace.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@cleartrace.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 11:27:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Onboarding: initial model shortlist & traffic ask

Monica — quick answers below, happy to expand on any item: 

- Typical prompt length: 90–150 tokens (median ~120). Prompts include a short user query + 1–2 contextual paragraphs.
- Expected response length: 220–400 tokens (average ~320). Some long explainers go up to ~1k tokens but are <5% of calls.
- Calls/day: currently planning for 120k API calls/day in month 1 post-launch; forecasted ramp to 420k calls/day by month 6 assuming feature rollout and marketing. Expect weekly spikes (~30% above baseline) during product updates.
- Latency constraints: user-facing assist flow target p95 < 800ms, background batch summarization can tolerate p95 up to 5s.
- Data sensitivity: prompts sometimes include customer emails and non-sensitive account metadata. No PHI. We need basic audit trail / retention controls.

Also attaching an internal note on expected feature mix (small file, not included here). If it helps, we can share a small sample of logs for token verification.

—Alex
Alex Klein | Head of Product Integrations, ClearTrace
alex.klein@cleartrace.com | +1 646-555-0123

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Klein <alex.klein@cleartrace.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@cleartrace.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: initial model shortlist & traffic ask

Team and ClearTrace — thanks for the details, Alex. I ran a quick top-level sizing and model recommendation based on the numbers (attached: model_capacity_notes.pdf and initial_shortlist_v1.csv). Summary below; note this is a preliminary handoff for the implementation plan.

Executive summary:
- Token projection (6 months): baseline month 1 = 120k calls/day * (120 prompt + 320 response avg) = ~53M tokens/day (~1.6B tokens/month). Month 6 = 420k calls/day => ~185M tokens/day (~5.5B tokens/month). Spikes add ~30% temporarily.
- Model shortlist (for evaluation):
  1) redwood-4o-base (2k context) — best latency/cost balance for the assist flow; good few-shot quality for our templates.
  2) redwood-4o-extended (8k context) — recommended for flows where you want extra context windows (longer conversation state).
  3) rw-3.1-q8_0 (8k quantized variant) — cost-efficient but needs validation for your longer explainers; target for background summarization jobs.

Sizing & throughput notes:
- For p95 < 800ms on assist flow using redwood-4o-base, estimate Dedicated sizing: pool equivalent of 4 x A100-80GB nodes for steady throughput with burst headroom. That maps to approx 200–300 concurrent requests depending on batching and KV cache hit rates.
- If ClearTrace opts for a mixed approach (hosted for background summarization + Dedicated for user-facing assist), we can reduce committed capacity to ~2 nodes and autoscale for peaks.
- Cache suggestion: enable prefix/KV caching for conversation state (expected 40–55% cache hit for repeat users) — will materially lower token compute and latency.

Next steps recommended for the implementation doc we will hand off to Infra/Dev:
- ClearTrace to provide 48–72 hours of sample logs (anonymized) so we can run token-distribution validation and tweak model quantization recommendations.
- Schedule a 60-minute technical sizing call (app-level engineers + Redwood infra) to lock on latency targets and rollout plan.
- Validation matrix: we'll run a 1-week A/B on redwood-4o-base vs rw-3.1-q8_0 for both latency and user-quality metrics.

Attachments: model_capacity_notes.pdf, initial_shortlist_v1.csv

Olga
